guides.title: Launch Day Prep
guides.subtitle: Get your console ready so you're playing the minute it unlocks.
guides.body:
## Before launch
- **Free up storage.** Big open-world games need a lot of space, and patches add more. Clear room well before launch day.
- **Update your console.** Install system updates now so they don't hold you up at midnight.
- **Turn on automatic downloads.** On PlayStation, enable Rest Mode downloads. On Xbox, use Energy Saving or Sleep with updates on.
- **Pre-load if you bought digital.** If pre-loading is offered, start it as soon as it opens.
## On launch night
- **Expect a day-one patch.** Leave time for it to download before you play.
- **Use a wired connection** if you can. It is usually faster and steadier than Wi-Fi.
- **Check the official site** for the exact unlock time in your region.

guides.title: What We Know So Far
guides.subtitle: The confirmed basics, with no rumors mixed in.
guides.body:
## The basics
- **Release:** November 19, 2026
- **Platforms:** PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S at launch
- **Setting:** Vice City and the surrounding state of Leonida, a fictional take on Florida
- **Leads:** Lucia and Jason, shown together in the trailers
## Not confirmed yet
Anything not listed above should be treated as unconfirmed. In the Home tab, rumors are always labeled RUMOR.

guides.title: How to Use This App
guides.subtitle: Countdown, timeline, guides and your personal tracker.
guides.body:
## Home
A live countdown, a launch-day reminder you can switch on, and a timeline of announcements. Each item is labeled **Official**, **Rumor** or **Community**.
## Guides
New guides are added after launch, with no app update needed. Pull down on any screen to refresh.
## Tracker
Tap items to check them off. Your progress is saved on your phone.
## Widget
Add the Launch Countdown widget to your Home Screen to see the days left at a glance.
